relay.title: Custom relay
relay.footer: Use an HTTP or HTTPS address. The access token is kept only in this device's secure storage.

space.title: My Space
space.footer: The device name, passphrase, and invitation code are used only for this operation and are not saved in app settings.

empty.title: Start with My Space
empty.body: Securely sync clipboard content between your devices.

create.title: Create a new space
create.description: Start a new encrypted space on this device

join.title: Join an existing space
join.description: Use an invitation generated on another device

flow.createTitle: Make this device the first one
flow.createBody: Choose how this device appears and protect the new space with a passphrase.
flow.joinCodeBody: The invitation is shown on a device already in the space.
flow.joinDetailsBody: Use the same space passphrase, then choose how this device appears.
flow.waitingBody: Keep this invitation open while the other device joins.
flow.successBody: This space is ready to sync clipboard content.
flow.shareMessage: Join my UniClip space with invitation {{code}}.

invitation.title: Invite another device
invitation.description: Generate a time-limited invitation for the current space.
invitation.pairingInstructions: Enter this invitation on the new device to join this space and finish pairing.
invitation.crossNetwork: This invitation can be used by a device on another network.
invitation.sameLocalNetwork: This invitation only works while both devices are on the same local network.

devices.title: Space devices
devices.removeConfirm: Remove this device from the space?

removal.title: Device removal
removal.waiting: Waiting for the remaining devices to confirm this removal.
removal.recoveryRequired: One or more devices have not confirmed. Mark a device as permanently unavailable only when you are certain it cannot return.
removal.permanentLossConfirm: {{device}} will be treated as permanently unavailable. This cannot be undone.
removal.complete: All remaining devices confirmed the removal.

leave.confirm: Your local history will stay on this device. Create or join a space again to resume syncing.

switch.title: Switch space
switch.description: Use an invitation code to join another space
switch.confirm: This device will leave the current space and join a new one. Your local history will stay, and it will only sync with the new space.

unreadableHistory.title: Some local history can't be opened
unreadableHistory.body: Those items will remain encrypted on this device but won't be available. The rest of your history will move to the new space. Continue?

error.title: Space needs attention
error.invitationNotFound: This invitation code does not exist
error.invitationExpired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one
error.sponsorUnreachable: The other device cannot be reached right now
error.connectionTimedOut: The connection timed out. Try again
error.invitationRejected: The other device did not accept this invitation
error.serviceUnavailable: The connection service is unavailable. Try again later
error.connectionLost: The connection was interrupted. Try again
error.operationFailed: The operation failed. Check your input and try again.
